Grant,

Per our agreement, there is a 10-day window for us to finalize the remaining financial matters. However, I am being rushed into surgery on Tuesday and will be unavailable for several weeks during recovery, which makes it difficult to complete any account transfers or receive a check in person during that time.

Please let me know the current status of getting my funds to me so we can ensure this is handled within the agreed timeline.

Please advise on how you would like to proceed so this can be resolved promptly.
